How to check it. Each card shows its number, player, team, the parallel call, and the two photo IDs it came from — front first, then back. If something looks wrong, quote the IMG number.

What the prices are. Each card carries the median asking price of the live raw listings for that exact player and parallel, with the spread and the comp count under it. Asks sit above sales, so treat these as the top of the range, not a valuation. Cards over $15 are dotted.

The base section is worth the closest skim: base and Logofractor look alike at thumbnail size, so a missed parallel would hide there.
